verdict.rationale: cfo.ai says it keeps one live model current, "rebuilt overnight off the close", from actuals synced from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Rillet. Connections refresh on a nightly schedule, and you can re-import past months after fixing them in your books, so you do not rebuild the model yourself. Missing for 10: documentation of how forecast periods actually re-baseline (actuals replacing forecast months, drivers rolling forward), and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.
